visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a steaming pot of long bean savory congee. A pink silicone ladle scoops out a portion showing grains of rice, sliced mushrooms, and green beans. The background is a brightly lit kitchen studio. (2) A person's hands are shown soaking dried shiitake mushrooms in a glass bowl and pouring wine over dried shrimp. The kitchen setting features soft, natural daylight from the side. (3) The host's hands chop red onions and scallions on a light-colored wooden cutting board. Various ingredients in small bowls are visible in the background. (4) Inside a red Le Creuset cast iron pot, oil is shimmering. Hands use chopsticks to stir-fry mushrooms, shrimp, and aromatics. (5) Rice is added to the pot and sautéed with a wooden spatula. Then, broth, pork ribs, and soaking liquid are poured in. The liquid bubbles steadily. (6) The pot lid is opened to reveal thickened congee. Sliced meat and green long beans are added and stirred. Toppings of white pepper and fried shallots are sprinkled on top. (7) A middle-aged woman with short dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a dark apron, stands in the kitchen. She holds a pink bowl and a wooden spoon, taking a bite of the congee. Her eyes close in enjoyment, and she smiles at the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 超級好吃又令人懷念的 長豆鹹粥. (2) [Subtitle]: 每一口都是幸福的滋味. (3) [Subtitle]: 香菇跟蝦米清洗乾淨. (4) [Subtitle]: 蝦米用酒浸泡. (5) [Subtitle]: 香菇洗乾淨 用溫水浸泡. (6) [Subtitle]: 一旁備用. (7) [Subtitle]: 切一點紅蔥頭. (8) [Subtitle]: 蔥白拍裂開來 釋放香味. (9) [Subtitle]: 蔥白切成長段. (10) [Subtitle]: 切一點蔥花. (11) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭拍裂開來. (12) [Subtitle]: 好囉，香菇已經泡開 擠乾水分. (13) [Subtitle]: 香菇去掉蒂，切成香菇絲. (14) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡倒入煸油蔥酥的油. (15) [Variety]: 需要完整食譜 請『舉手』. (16) [Subtitle]: 放入香菇絲 蝦米 蒜頭 紅蔥頭. (17) [Subtitle]: 開中小火爆香 直到香菇煸出表面焦香. (18) [Subtitle]: 這時候 放入蔥白. (19) [Subtitle]: 一撮白胡椒、一匙糖. (20) [Subtitle]: 嗆入醬油跟花雕酒 拌炒出香氣. (21) [Subtitle]: 把米清洗乾淨，瀝乾水分. (22) [Subtitle]: 充分拌炒出香氣. (23) [Subtitle]: 接著放入柴魚高湯. (24) [Subtitle]: 汆燙過的排骨. (25) [Subtitle]: 倒入香菇水.. (26) [Subtitle]: 慢慢的煮滾... (27) [Subtitle]: 邊煮邊撈掉浮沫... (28) [Subtitle]: 慢慢的煮到米粒漲開來 約煮35分鐘左右. (29) [Subtitle]: 再補一點水，滾了之後，關火悶15分鐘. (30) [Subtitle]: 等待的時候來切一點長豆. (31) [Subtitle]: 好囉！開蓋~ 重新加熱. (32) [Subtitle]: 再次的煮滾幾分鐘 讓米粒完全爆開. (33) [Subtitle]: 火轉到最小 放入肉絲燙一下. (34) [Subtitle]: 接著再放入長豆煮一分鐘. (35) [Subtitle]: 表留脆度即可. (36) [Subtitle]: 關火前來點白胡椒粉跟油蔥酥. (37) [Subtitle]: 一點蔥花 增加香氣. (38) [Subtitle]: 鹹粥搭配自己煸的油蔥酥 真的很香~. (39) [Subtitle]: 煮到爆開的米粒 就是好吃. (40) [Subtitle]: 滑順的粥搭配脆又甜的長豆. (41) [Subtitle]: 每一口幸福的滋味，大家一定要試試喔！
